original_input: A case closed by a decision stays open in Ask District IQ's figures, the officer's insights, the warnings, the AI brief's figures, news, threads, action mail and Data Studio's link.
path_driven: Real decisions on 3131 (POST /api/collector/decisions with confirm), then each surface: POST /api/collector/assistant/chat as Collector and officer; GET /api/officer/insights and /overview; the warning answer; GET /api/collector/overview stories; POST /api/map/ask and /api/map/send draft; the Jarvis round. The AI brief through a fake model at the gateway, capturing the facts it is given; Data Studio's list on the real store in the test, since no dataset exists to drive its route.

as officer: how many open incidents today
read right after, 65 s after, and minutes after
what_was_seen: The figures do follow: Ask District IQ "233 incidents still open · last 24 hours" from 236, the officer "22 incidents still open · last 24 hours" from "23 incidents still open · last 24 hours", officer insights "Closed=4% (1 of 23)", "Open past deadline=0 (of 22 still open)", the map's draft leaves the closed case out (has it: false), the warning's list and the AI brief's facts (earlier run and test), Data Studio's list says closed (test). But not everywhere at once, which is what the fix's own test title says. Right after, Jarvis still retells the closed case as open: "There's a street light or electrical problem at Perumal Koil 3Rd Colony. It's been open for about a day. It's one of the serious ones. I'd ask the corporation for an update."; 65 s later: "There was a street light or electrical problem at Perumal Koil 3Rd Colony. It's marked resolved, so there's nothing to chase unless it comes back.". Right after, Jarvis's brief says "reported=239 severe=9 overdue=11 newsOnly=13" while the console says overdue 9. The departments answer keeps PWD Water Resources at 242 right after and 241 at 65 s. A developing story still says open true right after its only case is resolved, and false 11 minutes later. Data Studio's cross-link has the same 10-minute cache, read in code only. A reopened case: "It is open; closed on 2026-11-05 15:49:39." (AUD-NF-14). A rejected one: "It is rejected, and past its deadline." (AUD-NF-19). News: the overview's news row for the closed case reads status Resolved, open 0. Action mail: the Map's batch draft leaves closed cases out; the Take action button is hidden on a closed case (Detail.tsx:173), though the route still drafts "needs your immediate attention" if called by hand (HTTP 200), which no screen reaches, so it is noted, not a finding. Finding AUD-NF-10.
